version: Set 19 Prismatic Tour / pre-release snapshot 2026-11-20 / TFT Flow Patch 19.1

sources.name: Set 19 base attack ranges (IES champion data)
sources.note: stats.offense.range in hexes; base roster only, excluding seven hero-augment overrides. Individual fields use HTTPS JSON-pointer provenance.

sources.name: TFT Ninja Set 19 champions
sources.note: Akali (K/DA) requires True Damage Akali not unlocked; Akali (True Damage) requires K/DA Akali not unlocked. These reciprocal unlock exclusions make the variants mutually exclusive.

sources.name: Mobalytics Set 19 unlock guide
sources.note: Tasks and player levels for all 32 currently unlockable champions; preferred when PBE numeric thresholds disagree.

sources.name: Blitz Set 19 unlock roster cross-check
sources.note: Both newer sources list 32 unlocks. The older Ninja roster marks Nasus, Renata Glasc, Galio and Syndra locked; the current complete eight-champion 1–3-cost quest table excludes all four. Blitz also explicitly places Nasus/Renata in the starting shop and Syndra in the normal 3-cost Beach Pop progression. These four are therefore stored without special unlock requirements.

traits.name: Arcanist
traits.description:
Your team gains Ability Power, Arcanists gain more.
2 Bonus Ability Power, more for Arcanists
4 Bonus Ability Power, more for Arcanists
6 Bonus Ability Power, more for Arcanists

traits.name: Beach Pop
traits.description:
Gain placeable instruments that empower adjacent allies. Empowered allies regenerate a portion of their Health periodically.
Empowered Beach Pop champions gain Attack Speed and also regenerate Mana periodically.
3 1 Instrument; bonus Attack Speed, Mana regeneration
5 2 Instruments; bonus Attack Speed, Mana regeneration
7 AND periodically, an ocean breeze heals Beach Pop champions and grants them Mana.

traits.name: Bodyguard
traits.description:
While at least one Bodyguard is alive, your team gains bonus Armor and Magic Resist. Bodyguards gain more.
2 Bonus Armor and Magic Resist for Bodyguards
4 Bonus Armor and Magic Resist for Bodyguards
6 Bonus Armor and Magic Resist for Bodyguards

traits.name: Choreographer
traits.description:
Allies who start in the front 2 rows gain Shield. All other allies gain Damage Amp. Choreographers gain double.
2 Shield; Damage Amp
3 Shield; Damage Amp
4 Shield; Damage Amp
5 Shield; Damage Amp

traits.name: Classical
traits.description:
Classical champions Captivate enemies in unique ways. They gain Damage Amp, increased periodically while an enemy is Captivated.
2 Bonus Damage Amp; the Captivated deal reduced damage.
4 Bonus Damage Amp; the Captivated throw roses on death, healing a Classical champion.
6 Bonus Damage Amp; the Captivated have a chance to join your bench on death.

traits.name: Encore

3 and bonus Health per level.

traits.name: Hitmaker
traits.description:
Hitmakers gain bonus Attack Damage. The Hitmakers with the most items become Big Shots, gaining even more Attack Damage.
2 Big Shot, bonus Attack Damage
4 Big Shots, bonus Attack Damage

traits.name: Hyperpop
traits.description:
Hyperpop champions gain Health and Attack Speed. After player combat, they generate 4/6/12/40 Hype based on their star level + 1 Hype per takedown.
Each time you hit a new Hype Level, gain special rewards! At higher trait tiers, gain more Hype!
2 Bonus Health, bonus Attack Speed
3 Bonus Health, bonus Attack Speed, Hype multiplier
4 Bonus Health, bonus Attack Speed, Hype multiplier
5 Bonus Health, bonus Attack Speed, Hype multiplier

traits.name: Illbeats
traits.description:
Open the Illbeats Mixer to allocate Decibels. Illbeats champions receive different stats based on your mix. Your team gains a portion of the mix.

Health

Fans cheer on Ionic Spark members with gifts periodically. Ionic Spark members gain Health.
3 Bonus Health; Letters that restore Health and grant Attack Speed
5 Bonus Health; Personalized gifts that grant Attack Damage or Ability Power

traits.name: Jazz
traits.description:
For each active trait (except uniques), your team gains bonus Health and Damage Amp.

traits.name: K/DA
traits.description:
K/DA champions release new songs based on their total star level. At Combat Start and after a delay, they gain power for each of their songs.
3 POP/STARS: Reduced max Mana.
5 DRUM GO DUM: Shield based on max Health.
7 VILLAIN: Attack Speed that decays over time.
10 I'LL SHOW YOU: Boost all previous effects.
13 WATCH ME: Stun all enemies temporarily.
15 FIRESTARTER: Enemies take magic damage based on their max Health over time.
21 GIRLS: K/DA members ascend to 4-star.

traits.name: Manager
traits.description:
Gain a Spotlight Hex. The ally who starts combat in it gains bonuses at Combat Start and periodically thereafter.
2 Bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power
3 AND Mana
4 AND they drop Gold!

traits.name: Pentakill
traits.description:
Pentakill members gain Attack Damage and Ability Power.
The first few enemies to drop below a Health threshold are executed and summon an allied ghoul in their place.
3 Bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power, a set number of enemies executed
5 Bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power, a set number of enemies executed
7 Bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power, a set number of enemies executed. The first enemy to die summons the Iron Maiden instead.
7 Bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power. MOSH PIT!!!!!!!

Your team gains bonus Mana Regen. Prodigies gain more.

traits.name: R&B
traits.description:
1 Your team takes less damage from abilities.
2 Your strongest Mel and Rell are soul-linked. A portion of damage Mel takes is redirected to Rell. Rell heals for a portion of damage dealt by Mel.

traits.name: Renegade
traits.description:
Renegades gain Precision, Critical Strike Chance, and Critical Strike Damage.
2 Bonus Critical Strike Chance, bonus Critical Strike Damage
3 Bonus Critical Strike Chance, bonus Critical Strike Damage
4 Bonus Critical Strike Chance, bonus Critical Strike Damage

traits.name: Rock
traits.description:
3 Summon the Infernal Idol.
4 He heals for a portion of damage dealt by Rock champions.
5 On cast, he fires a massive blast through the most enemies!
7 Periodically while he lives, bolts blast nearby enemies, repeating a portion of damage dealt by Rock champions as magic damage.
The Infernal Idol grows stronger based on the star level of your Rock champions.

traits.description:
Slayers gain Attack Speed and Omnivamp, which increases up to a cap, based on their missing Health.
2 Bonus Attack Speed, bonus Omnivamp
4 Bonus Attack Speed, bonus Omnivamp

Your team gains Attack Speed.

traits.description:

traits.name: True Damage
traits.description:
While on the A-Side, earn Bling for winning player combat. On the B-Side, earn Bling for losing.
Periodically, choose to convert Bling into rewards or Keep Rising.
A-Side: Win
3 True Damage members deal bonus true damage. Gain Bling on kill + additional Bling if you win combat.
5 Bonus true damage. Bling on kill + additional Bling if you win combat.
Prismatic: KNOW MY NAME blasts from the record player!
True Damage members deal 99% bonus true damage and earn double the bling.
B-Side: Lose
3 After losing, gain Bling + additional Bling per consecutive loss on the B-Side. If you win, lose a portion of your Bling.
5 Each round after combat, heal some player Health and gain XP.
Prismatic: GIANTS blasts from the record player!
True Damage members deal 99% bonus true damage and drop gold on kill.

traits.name: 8-Bit
traits.description: 1 Keep score of your team's damage dealt, with Miss Fortune’s damage contributing triple. When you beat a high score, get a prize.

traits.name: Beat Master
traits.description:
1 At a threshold of her max Health, Rell mounts up and fully heals over time.
While mounted, her max Mana is reduced and every 3rd attack deals a portion of her total Armor and Magic Resist as magic damage in a line.

traits.name: Boy Band
traits.description: 1 Rakan is accompanied by placeable clones that have a portion of his max Health, deal damage, and copy his Completed and Radiant items.

traits.name: Collab
traits.description:
Collab champions become inspired after taking or dealing damage a set number of times, gaining Attack Damage and Ability Power.
Every time you reach the required number of inspirations during player combat, gain copies of Collab champions.
3 Bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power
5 Bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power
Each game a different set of champions gain the Collab trait!

traits.name: Composer
traits.description:
1 Mystical Instruments can appear in your shop. There is one of each rarity.
For each one you have, your team gains bonus Ability Power. Malzahar gains double.
If he has dealt enough damage and you have all 5 instruments, Malzahar writes his masterpiece, unlocking Baron Nashor.

traits.name: Country
traits.description: 1 Combat Start: If your strongest Alistar has enough bonus Health, he gains Durability.

traits.name: Disco
traits.description:
1 Your team heals for a portion of max Health per second.
Enter Disco Fever after casting enough times, granting your team Attack Speed.

traits.name: Emo
traits.description: 1 Amumu gains bonus Armor and Magic Resist if he starts combat with no adjacent allies.

traits.name: Freestyle
traits.description: 1 Akali gains a different passive on each side of the True Damage record. A-Side prints gold. B-Side restores Player Health.

traits.name: Goth
traits.description: 1 The first time your strongest Zeri damages an enemy each combat, vampiric bats steal some Attack Damage from them, bringing it back to her.

traits.name: Hype Man

traits.name: Indie
traits.description:
1 After combat, Seraphine attracts new followers, granting you a random champion.
When you 3-star a champion, she becomes a Rising Star, upgrading her Ability and granting you a special subscriber reward.
After 3-starring enough champions, she becomes a Superstar!

traits.name: Mariachi
traits.description:
1 When Nidalee casts her Ability while above a Health threshold, she transforms into Cougar Form and casts Pounce Party. Otherwise, she casts Dance of Life.
Whenever she drops below a Health threshold, she leaps away and transforms back to Human form.

traits.name: Melodic Heart
traits.description: 1 For the opening moments of combat, your strongest Gwen is surrounded by Mist and cannot be targeted by attacks. Allies gain Durability while within the Mist.

traits.name: One Monster Band
traits.description:
1 Baron Nashor takes up 2 team slots and is unstoppable.
After the first time Baron Nashor casts, he envelops the board in song, stealing a portion of the Attack Damage, Ability Power, Attack Speed, and Critical Strike Chance from all enemies.

traits.name: Producer
traits.description:
1 When Sona is fielded, choose a band to feature, gaining their trait.
Sona converts all bonus Attack Damage and Attack Speed into Ability Power.

traits.name: Record Mogul
traits.description:
1 Gain a Record Contract now and periodically thereafter. Contracted champions gain Damage Amp and their kills grant Dr. Mundo permanent Health.
The Record Contract is returned when the Recording Artist is sold or benched.

traits.name: Synthwave
traits.description: 1 At a Health threshold, gain a temporary Shield equal to a portion of Healing and Shielding received this combat.

traits.name: Tango
traits.description:
1 Twisted Fate marks the nearest ally as his Tango Partner. They ignite with passion, gaining Attack Speed. Their damage Burns and Wounds enemies for a time.
Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second.
Wound: Reduces healing received.
